title: cogswellia suksdorfii

It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of gastrointestinal issues, such as constipation and diarrhea. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
